title: Debating an Opinion

expressions.expr: Having said that, I still think we need more evidence
expressions.meaning: Dito isso, ainda acho que precisamos de mais evidências
expressions.example: Having said that, I still think we need more evidence.

expressions.expr: On the whole, I agree with your point of view

expressions.expr: The way I see it, both sides have valid arguments

sentences: Having said that, I still think we need more evidence.
On the whole, I agree with your point of view.
The way I see it, both sides have valid arguments.
I see your point, but I'd like to add something.
Let's agree to disagree on this one.
That's a fair point, but consider this instead.
At the end of the day, we want the same outcome.
I used to think that way, but I've changed my mind.

grammar.title: Estruturas de Debate (Having said that / On the whole / The way I see it)
rules: "Having said that" introduz um contraste após reconhecer um ponto: Having said that, I still disagree.
"On the whole" resume uma opinião geral considerando tudo: On the whole, I agree with you.
"The way I see it" introduz uma opinião pessoal de forma educada: The way I see it, both sides are right.
"I see your point, but..." reconhece o argumento do outro antes de discordar educadamente.
